STT GDC is a leading hyperscale-focused data center operator, with a presence across twelve markets and market-leading positions in Singapore, India and the United Kingdom.

Across Asia, demand for digital infrastructure is surging, but the supply of high-quality capacity is not keeping pace. \r\n STTGDC is a leading hyperscale-focused data center operator, with a presence across twelve markets and market-leading positions in Singapore, India and the United Kingdom. \r\n More than 90 percent of demand comes from hyperscale customers, who lease capacity under long-term contracts. Its secured land bank across tier-one cities in Asia and Europe gives the platform a foundation for growth that new entrants would need years to replicate. \r\n Since our initial investment in 2024, KKR has deepened its commitment to STTGDC, working closely with management on the platform's growth. Drawing on the combined capabilities of our Infrastructure and Real Estate teams, we’re accelerating the expansion of STTGDC’s land bank, positioning the platform for the next wave of AI demand, and expanding into high-growth markets across the region. \r\n Watch this episode of Here's the Deal to learn more. \r\n"}}" id="text-2ac7f50b85"> Across Asia, demand for digital infrastructure is surging, but the supply of high-quality capacity is not keeping pace.

Since our initial investment in 2024, KKR has deepened its commitment to STTGDC, working closely with management on the platform's growth. Drawing on the combined capabilities of our Infrastructure and Real Estate teams, we’re accelerating the expansion of STTGDC’s land bank, positioning the platform for the next wave of AI demand, and expanding into high-growth markets across the region.

Watch this episode of Here's the Deal to learn more.

p: STTGDC는 하이스케일 중심의 선도적인 데이터센터 운용사로, 12개 시장에 진출해 있으며 싱가포르, 인도, 영국에서 시장 지배적 지위를 확보하고 있습니다.
아시아 전역에서 디지털 인프라에 대한 수요가 급증하고 있으나, 고품질 용량의 공급은 이를 따라가지 못하고 있습니다.
2024년 초기 투자 이후 KKR은 경영진과 긴밀히 협력하며 플랫폼의 성장을 위해 STTGDC에 대한 투자를 확대해 왔습니다. 인프라 및 부동산 팀의 역량을 결합하여 STTGDC의 랜드뱅크 확장을 가속화하고, 다가오는 AI 수요 물결에 맞춰 플랫폼을 포지셔닝하며, 해당 지역 내 고성장 시장으로 확장해 나가고 있습니다.
